Sheer curtains filter soft morning light from a large window, a wool rug and a small ceramic lamp on the nightstand. Clean minimalist interior design photography, eye level, calm neutral palette.

pendentes.alt: Hall de casa contemporânea com elevador residencial de portas de vidro ao lado de uma escada de madeira
pendentes.pedido: A contemporary two-story house interior with a sleek residential elevator enclosed in clear glass panels and a slim bronze metal frame, standing beside a floating oak staircase. Light travertine floor, white walls, a large potted olive tree and soft daylight from a tall window. Elegant interior design photography, wide angle, eye level, quiet empty space.

pendentes.alt: Parede de banheiro com porcelanato claro de grandes formatos e juntas finas e retas em tom cinza-claro
pendentes.pedido: A close-up interior photograph of a bright bathroom wall clad in large light-beige porcelain tiles with thin, perfectly straight light-gray grout lines. A minimalist niche with a ceramic soap dish and a folded white towel, soft natural light grazing the surface to reveal the texture. Clean architectural detail photography, slightly angled view.

pendentes.alt: Terreno de obra limpo com fôrmas de madeira e armaduras de aço prontas para a concretagem da fundação de uma casa
pendentes.pedido: A clean residential construction site at the foundation stage, seen from a slightly elevated angle. Neat timber formwork and steel rebar cages laid in shallow trenches on reddish compacted soil, a few stacked concrete blocks and a rolled set of architectural drawings on a wooden plank. Green trees in the background, soft morning light, architectural photography.

pendentes.alt: Telhado cerâmico de uma casa com coletores solares para aquecimento de água e reservatório térmico sob céu azul
pendentes.pedido: A modern detached house with a terracotta tile roof carrying two flat solar water heating collectors and a cylindrical stainless steel thermal storage tank. Clear blue sky, tropical trees around the house, late morning sunlight. Wide-angle architectural photography from a slightly elevated viewpoint, crisp details, natural colors.

pendentes.alt: Quarto com parede de cabeceira revestida de papel de parede com estampa botânica discreta em tons de verde e bege
pendentes.pedido: A serene bedroom with the headboard wall covered in a subtle botanical wallpaper in soft sage green and beige tones. A low upholstered bed with natural linen bedding, a solid oak nightstand with a ceramic lamp, and a jute rug on light wood flooring. Soft diffused daylight from a side window, interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Parede de cobogós cerâmicos brancos com desenho geométrico projetando sombras sobre um piso de cimento claro, ao lado de plantas
pendentes.pedido: A tall interior wall made of white ceramic breeze blocks with a geometric hollow pattern, separating a bright living area from a small garden. Late afternoon sunlight passes through the openings and casts a precise pattern of light and shadow on a pale polished concrete floor. A large potted fiddle-leaf fig and a low wooden bench nearby. Architectural interior photography, eye level, soft warm tones.

pendentes.alt: Rua residencial curva e arborizada, com calçada larga, gramado e casas baixas de jardim na frente sob a copa das árvores
pendentes.pedido: A quiet curving residential street lined with large mature shade trees whose canopies meet over the asphalt. Wide sidewalks with grass strips, low garden walls and detached houses with front lawns set back from the street. A small triangular green square at the corner. Soft morning light filtering through the leaves, urban landscape photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Vasos de barro com manjericão, alecrim, salsa e cebolinha sobre uma bancada de madeira junto a uma janela ensolarada
pendentes.pedido: A row of terracotta pots with fresh basil, rosemary, parsley and chives on a wooden shelf beside a large sunny kitchen window. A small watering can in brushed metal and a ceramic saucer under each pot. Bright natural morning light, green leaves in sharp focus, a softly blurred white kitchen in the background. Interior lifestyle photography, close eye-level angle.

pendentes.alt: Rua residencial arborizada ao entardecer, com casas baixas, calçadas largas e copas de árvores floridas
pendentes.pedido: A quiet tree-lined residential street in a mid-sized Brazilian city at golden hour. Low modern houses with light plaster facades, wooden gates and green front gardens, wide sidewalks and flowering trees with purple and yellow blossoms. Soft warm sunlight filtering through the canopy, gentle hills in the distance. Wide-angle architectural photography, eye level, no cars in focus.

pendentes.alt: Obra limpa de casa com laje de concreto recém-concretada, escoras metálicas e plantas de arquitetura enroladas sobre uma mesa
pendentes.pedido: A clean residential construction site seen from inside the ground floor of a two-story concrete house. A freshly cast smooth concrete slab overhead supported by rows of adjustable steel props, exposed concrete columns, neat stacks of ceramic filler blocks and steel rebar bundles on the floor. Rolled architectural drawings on a plywood table in the foreground. Soft morning daylight through open window frames, architectural photography, wide angle.

pendentes.alt: Mesa de jantar de madeira com cadeiras estofadas e dois pendentes de vidro âmbar acesos sobre o tampo
pendentes.pedido: A warm contemporary dining room with a long solid oak dining table and six upholstered chairs in sand-colored fabric. Two globe pendant lights in amber glass hang low and centered above the tabletop, softly lit. A ceramic bowl with green branches on the table, white plaster walls and a large window with sheer linen curtains. Early evening light, interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Laje de uma casa moderna coberta por um telhado verde baixo, com plantas rasteiras e suculentas, sob a luz suave do fim de tarde
pendentes.pedido: A modern single-story house with a flat green roof covered in low sedum, succulents and native grasses, seen from a slightly elevated angle. Clean white concrete walls, large glass windows and a wooden deck below. A gravel border and a slim metal edge frame the planted roof. Soft late-afternoon sunlight, architectural photography, wide angle.

pendentes.alt: Sala clara com piso de porcelanato acetinado, tapete de fibra natural, sofá em tecido liso e uma cama de pet em madeira junto à janela
pendentes.pedido: A bright, calm living room designed for pets: a satin-finish light porcelain tile floor, a large flat-woven natural fiber rug, a low sofa upholstered in smooth tightly woven sage-green fabric, and a small wooden pet bed with a cushion beside a floor-to-ceiling window. A built-in wooden bench with a low open niche holds two ceramic bowls. Potted orchids and a bromeliad on a side table. Soft morning daylight, interior design photography, eye level, no animals.

pendentes.alt: Varanda moderna com guarda-corpo de vidro transparente fixado em perfis de aço inox, piso de madeira e vista para árvores
pendentes.pedido: A modern residential balcony with a frameless clear glass balustrade fixed in a slim stainless steel base channel, a light wooden deck floor and two low outdoor armchairs in teak. Beyond the glass, a soft view of green tree canopies. Bright natural daylight with gentle reflections on the glass, architectural photography, eye level, wide angle.

pendentes.alt: Garagem residencial moderna com carregador de parede para carro elétrico e cabo enrolado, piso de concreto polido
pendentes.pedido: A clean modern residential garage with a polished light concrete floor and white walls. A compact wall-mounted electric vehicle charging station with a neatly coiled black cable is fixed on the wall beside a wooden slatted panel. Soft daylight enters from a high horizontal window, a potted olive tree stands in the corner. Architectural photography, eye level, no car in the frame.

pendentes.alt: Cozinha clara em U com bancada de pedra, cuba sob a janela, cooktop de um lado e geladeira embutida do outro
pendentes.pedido: A bright U-shaped kitchen with matte sage-green cabinets and a pale stone countertop. An undermount sink sits beneath a wide window, an induction cooktop is on the left run and a tall built-in refrigerator with wood panel doors on the right. A wall oven installed at eye level in a tall cabinet, brass handles, light oak floor. Soft morning daylight, interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.
